evidence.note: Refrigerator's main upper door is fully closed.

Main refrigerator compartment is visibly open and illuminated.
Refrigerator remains open in the background.
Hand is pushing the open refrigerator door toward its frame.
Refrigerator door is fully closed again.

evidence.note: Left leaf of the upper cabinet above the cooktop is closed.
Cabinet interior has become exposed as the left leaf opens.
Left cabinet leaf is fully open.
Left leaf remains open late in the sequence.
Hand reaches the open leaf to begin the closing sequence.
Left leaf is flush and closed.

Hand manipulates the second cabinet leaf outward.
Both leaves are open, including the right leaf.

events.object_description: Right door leaf of the two-door upper cabinet above the cooktop and range hood

evidence.note: Top drawer immediately right of the oven is closed.
Hand grasps the drawer handle and begins pulling.
Drawer is visibly open with its contents exposed.
Drawer remains fully open.
Hand pushes the drawer inward.

events.object_description: Top storage drawer immediately to the right of the oven

notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are visible. The two upper-cabinet leaves close within the same sparsely sampled 592–600 interval, so their individual closure order and midpoint assignments are approximate.
scene_description: A user surveys a compact kitchen, opens the refrigerator, separately opens both leaves of the upper cabinet above the cooktop, closes the refrigerator, opens and later closes the top drawer beside the oven, and finally closes both upper-cabinet leaves.
